translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Aluongi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, yie ibi ira piyo.
Yie iwinj dwonda ka aluongi.
Mad lamona osiki e nyimi mana ka ubani miwangʼo,
kendo bedena osik koriere kochomo malo mana ka misango mitimoni godhiambo.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ket jarit e dhoga;
ketna jarit mondo okonya umo dhoga.
Kik iyie gimoro amora marach ywa chunya,
ma dimi an bende atim timbe maricho,
kaachiel gi joma timbe gi richo;
rita mondo kik acham chiembgi mabeyonegi.
Onego ngʼat makare ema ogoya, nikech mano chalo tim ngʼwono motimona;
onego en ema okwera, nikech mano chalo mo mool e wiya;
ok anyal dagi mondo ngʼama kare otimna kamano.
To kata kamano obiro kwedo timbe joma richo e lemona;
chiengʼ ma nowit ruodhigi piny koa ewi got mabor,
eka joma timbegi richo nongʼe ni kare wechena ne gin adier.
Giniwach niya, “Mana kaka ngʼato puro kendo toyo lowo,
e kaka chokewa osekere e dho bur liel.”
Anto atego wangʼa kuomi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto;
In e kar pondona, omiyo kik iwe atho.
Kik iwe obadho ma gisechikona maka,
ee, resa kuom otegu ma joma timbegi richo ochikona.
Mad joma timbegi richogo moki e gokegi giwegi
ka anto akadho maber mak gimoro otima.
